description:
Free Digital Painting Software

FireAlpaca is the free digital painting software compatible with both Mac and Windows, supporting 10 languages. The Windows 64-bit version runs on Windows 10 or later, and Windows, macOS, and Linux versions are all available for free. It provides a lightweight yet powerful painting environment with tools such as the Pose Doll 3D character posing, perspective rulers, a line stabilizer, and text tools.
- We've added a mode to the Move tool's 1px move mode that allows you to specify the amount of movement.
- A "Free Transform" option has been added to the selection menu, allowing you to start free transformation directly.
- Improved the border when the foreground and background colors of the color window are active.
- Fixed an issue where the reference window's documents were not restored after restarting the app.
- Fixed a bug where the canvas display would move up and down when confirming or canceling layer transformations.
- You can now add a layer below the active layer by holding down Shift (Ctrl) and clicking the Add Layer button.
- We have also added “New,” “Add,” and “Select Common Areas” options to the Auto Select tool.
- We increased the amount of information displayed in the dialog box at startup.
